# Calculate 52^12
result = 52 ** 12

# Convert to string to get all digits
result_str = str(result)

# Sum all the digits
digit_sum = sum(int(digit) for digit in result_str)

print(f"52^12 = {result}")
print(f"Sum of decimal digits: {digit_sum}")
print(f"ANSWER: {digit_sum}")
